app.name: XCHK Verification
app.short_description: Open live identity verification for this ticket.
app.long_description: Launch XCHK helpdesk verification with the ticket requester email and phone. Agents run a live verify session in XCHK; PASS/FAIL can sync back to the Zendesk ticket when OAuth is connected in XCHK.
app.installation_instructions:
1. In XCHK helpdesk, open **API & Webhooks → Integrations** and generate an API key.

2. In Zendesk Admin → **Apps and integrations → Zendesk Support apps**, install XCHK Verification.

3. Set **XCHK base URL** to `https://in.xchk.io` (or your XCHK host).

4. Set **XCHK integrator token** to the API key from step 1 (secure field).

5. Optionally set **Zendesk subdomain override** if auto-detection fails.

6. In XCHK, open **API & Webhooks → Zendesk** and connect OAuth for PASS/FAIL ticket sync.

xchk_integrator_token.label: XCHK integrator token
xchk_integrator_token.helpText: API key from XCHK helpdesk → API & Webhooks → Integrations → Generate key

zendesk_subdomain.label: Zendesk subdomain override (optional)
zendesk_subdomain.helpText: Leave blank to auto-detect from the current Zendesk account
